verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no in-product feature that produces AI-generated insights or suggestions from the user's data. The Connector Builder AI Assistant only prefills connector configuration fields, which is an adjacent feature. Airbyte Agents and the MCP servers feed data to external agents such as Claude or Cursor, a developer building block rather than insights delivered inside Airbyte.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
